typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style KitPrompt.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style KitBreak.

recognitionRules: Use large numbered stage labels and separate evidence slips.
Pair Avenir display labels with Noto Sans working text.
Keep one prompt or observation per movable unit.
Distinguish an observed record from an idea or a chosen test through explicit headings.
Use the source row of outlined prompt shapes with amber, sage and warm-paper fills; keep burgundy stage labels and black working text distinct.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Put the evidence where the team can see it. Choose one thing to test.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use FRAME TO TEST in Avenir with four spaced short rules representing stages. No lightning bolt or sprint mascot.
invariants: Use large numbered stage labels and separate evidence slips.
Pair Avenir display labels with Noto Sans working text.
Keep one prompt or observation per movable unit.
adaptations: Small groups can use tabletop sheets instead of a wall.
Keep the evidence-slip labels in photographed or digital versions.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Avenir Next is a separately licensed Apple/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
